title: OpenAI’s New Offline Training Policy: What It Means for Model Security
description:
OpenAI just confirmed they’ve moved their most advanced models to offline-only training after a security breach. We’re breaking down what this means for the future of AI containment and why your favorite tools might get a little slower.

What we covered:
• OpenAI moves to offline training for frontier models after security incident
• Meta acquires AI data analytics startup Sundial
• Anthropic says AI is reshaping work inside the company, but outside experts question the evidence

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: If your company replaced 20% of your team's tasks with AI agents, would you feel more productive or just like a 'manager' of software?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
